t.why: A NATO member on the Black Sea, hosting US and NATO troops.
t.rel: It shares language and history with Moldova and actively supports Moldova's bid to join the EU. Logistics cooperation has grown as Ukrainian grain is exported through Romanian ports and roads. With Hungary, the ethnic Hungarian minority in Romania is a long-standing issue.
t.know: It is home to Transylvania, the setting of the Dracula legend.
t.etext: Cars and parts, machinery and IT services have grown. Development of a Black Sea gas field is ahead. Its budget deficit is among the largest in the EU.
